scenario: A simple reminder check that receives a retried webhook delivery.

turns.text: Remind me to feed the fish in two hours.
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event Ev0123ABCD detected by the connector.
Got it, I'll remind you to feed the fish in two hours.

expected.agent_should: ignore the duplicate event and send only one reminder confirmation reply.

scenario: An owner follows up on a parking request within a thread to clarify details.

turns.text: Can you reserve a small parking spot for later today?
Sure, which lot are you hoping for?
Lot three would work best.
Reserved a small spot in lot three for later today. I'll ping you if anything changes.

expected.agent_should: keep all replies within the parent thread and only respond to the owner's clarifying messages.

scenario: The owner asks for a multi-item grocery summary that requires reading a long block of text.

turns.text: Summarize these grocery items for me: eggs, milk, oat flour, canned lentils, frozen green beans, almond butter, plain yogurt, brown rice, yellow onions, red potatoes, dried oregano, olive oil, low sodium stock, dark chocolate, and bananas.

Okay, I've broken it down: produce (bananas, red potatoes, yellow onions, frozen green beans), dairy (eggs, milk, plain yogurt), pantry (brown rice, dried oregano, olive oil, low sodium stock, oat flour, canned lentils), and extras (almond butter, dark chocolate). Would you like a checklist as well?
Yes, please give me a short checklist I can tick off.

Checklist: [ ] eggs, [ ] milk, [ ] oat flour, [ ] canned lentils, [ ] frozen green beans, [ ] almond butter, [ ] plain yogurt, [ ] brown rice, [ ] yellow onions, [ ] red potatoes, [ ] dried oregano, [ ] olive oil, [ ] low sodium stock, [ ] dark chocolate, [ ] bananas.

expected.agent_should: retain and accurately summarize the full list without truncating key items.

scenario: A quick scheduling question is retried twice, testing that retries do not spam the thread.

turns.text: Can we move the afternoon catch-up to five o'clock instead?
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event Ev0123ABCI detected by the connector.
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event Ev0123ABCI detected by the connector.
Sure, the afternoon catch-up has been moved to five o'clock.

expected.agent_should: deduplicate all retries and send exactly one confirmation within the thread.

scenario: The owner requests a daily recap with a large amount of context before asking for a follow-up.

turns.text: Give me a recap of today's tasks: submit the draft notes, reply to the design feedback from alex.lee@example.com, check the backup status, confirm the room booking for the client check-in, update the access list, review the quote for the small order, and prep an outline for next week's walk-through.

Recap: 1) Submit draft notes (in progress), 2) Reply to design feedback, 3) Check backup status, 4) Confirm room booking for the client check-in, 5) Update the access list, 6) Review the quote for the small order, 7) Prep an outline for next week's walk-through. Anything you want to prioritize?
Prioritize the client check-in items and the quote first.
Priority order: first, confirm the room booking for the client check-in and update the access list as needed, then review the quote for the small order before moving to the rest of the list.

expected.agent_should: process the full task set and correctly re-prioritize based off of the follow-up.

scenario: A short check-in with no edge cases to confirm the connector's default behavior.

turns.text: How's my day looking so far?
Your day looks clear for now, with no upcoming reminders.
Thanks, I'll check back later.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need anything else.

expected.agent_should: respond normally with no special deduplication, threading, or event handling required.

scenario: An unrecognized sender attempts to reach the agent through a direct message.

turns.text: DM received from a non-allowlisted sender. Connection rejected.
No reply sent to the non-allowlisted sender.
Access attempt logged to the audit trail for future review.

expected.agent_should: Ignore all incoming messages from non-allowlisted senders and refuse to disclose assistant information.

scenario: The owner celebrates a completed task list using a wide array of emojis.

turns.text: 🎉 Task list complete! All done for the day 😎✨
Fantastic work! Take the rest of the day to relax. 💚
Thanks so much! Going to enjoy a nice walk outside. 🌻
That sounds lovely. Don't forget to stay hydrated! 🚰

scenario: The owner sends a burst of short questions while in a hurry.

Can I still add to the lunch slot?
Mostly sunny with a chance of clouds for today.
Your only upcoming reminder is a quick check-in at noon.

scenario: The owner uses a thread to follow up on a previously requested summary.

Which one is due first?

yes
